subject: Re: Satori Labs integrator instructor fellowship — pilot proposal
messages:
From: Emma Zhou <emma@satorilabs.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Integrator instructor fellowship — pilot ask

Hi Diego,

Quick intro — I'm Emma, Head of Partnerships at Satori Labs. We're a boutique systems integrator focused on LLM productization for mid-market finance and healthcare customers. We ran a short internal trainer cohort using Redwood last quarter and are interested in formalizing an "Integrator Instructor Fellowship" to certify SIs to deliver Redwood-powered solutions.

High-level ask:
- Pilot with 6 SIs (2-day remote workshop + ongoing shadowing)
- Co-branded materials and a train-the-trainer run
- Shared success metrics: 3 qualified opportunities (POC stage) within 90 days

I've attached a short partnership brief. Can we schedule 30m this week to run through logistics and potential costs? Our preferred time windows are Thurs 9–11am PT or Fri 1–3pm PT.

Thanks,

Emma Zhou
Head of Partnerships | Satori Labs
emma@satorilabs.com
Attachment: satori-fellowship-brief.pdf (application/pdf)

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma@satorilabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator instructor fellowship — pilot ask

Emma — great to meet you over email, thanks for the brief.

We're interested. Internal folks looped: Laura (Partner Programs), Jonas (Enablement lead), Kimberly (Field enablement ops). Quick notes from our side:
- We can support a 2-day remote workshop + 4 weeks of structured shadowing (hours budgeted)
- Suggested commercial model: Redwood-sponsored pilot credit + revenue share for SI certifications
- Need to validate: licensing for labs, dedicated sandbox capacity, and trainer compensation

Laura/Jonas/Kim — can you review the attached availability matrix and the sketch below? I'd like to propose the pilot week of Oct 18th. Emma — does that work for you?

Proposed next steps:
1) 30m sync this week to align scope + timeline
2) Redwood to circulate a draft pilot MOU and trainer syllabus
3) Joint kickoff with selected SIs

Diego Fernandez
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com
Attachment: training-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

Emma,

Thanks — attached is a draft "Instructor Fellowship Syllabus" that scopes learning objectives, hands-on labs, evaluation rubric, and recommended trainer time allocation. A few clarifying questions:
- On success metrics: do you want opportunities contributed to a joint pipeline in HubSpot or separate tracking?
- Will Satori provide seed attendee lists for the pilot SIs or should we recruit from our existing integrator cohort?

Operational notes:
- We can provision a dedicated sandbox per SI for the 2-day workshop; need a short IP waiver for shared lab prompts
- We'll propose Redwood credits to cover GPU load for the pilot

If the syllabus looks good, Jonas and I can convert it into a trainer slide deck and run a dry-run with one SI the week before pilot.

Laura Bennett
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
